title: Uncategorized's page
stem: What should Uncategorized's page show and allow?

options.t: Read only, with no rename, no Delete and no matrix picker, as the PRD says
As the design draws: a grayed Pricing Matrix box, a grayed Tax Exempt box and a QuickBooks Products And Services picker that can be changed
Something else (please say whether its QuickBooks mapping and Tax Exempt can be changed).

context: The PRD says Uncategorized's page is read only "with no rename, Delete or matrix picker". The design shows the matrix field grayed and a QuickBooks picker that looks editable.
where: PRD Story 8 (Uncategorized); Tiered Pricing design canvas, picture 8.3
